subject: Access reconciliation & attribute matrix check-in / SSO + SCIM deliverables
messages:
From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@signalcare.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SignalCare Security <security@signalcare.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: canonical SAML samples + SCIM delta + role ownership map for SOC2 audit

Sean — thanks for taking this. We're kicking off our SOC 2 Type II evidence collection and AuditWise has asked for a specific set of artifacts to validate provisioning and least-privilege controls. Can you provide the following for SignalCare's tenant?

- A small sample of SAML assertions (canonicalized) from the last 30 days (include typical attributes and any standard NameID formats)
- SCIM delta export showing provisioning events (CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE) for Nov 2027
- The RBAC role-to-permission matrix and the current owner roster for each role (owner email + manager)
- A brief description (one paragraph) of how we bind SAML attributes to role assignment (attribute mapping rules)

If possible we'd like these by EOD Friday 3 Dec to keep the audit on schedule. If any of this requires an escalation (e.g., data that lives in a private deployment), let me know and we can coordinate an NDA/secure transfer.

Thanks — Amanda
Amanda Li
Senior InfoSec Manager, SignalCare

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@signalcare.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: canonical SAML samples + SCIM delta + role ownership map for SOC2 audit

Amanda — appreciate the clear list. Quick notes on availability and approach:

- SAML assertions: we can export canonicalized assertion samples (redacted token IDs) from the hosted logs. We'll include both a typical user login and a service-to-service assertion used by our provisioning job.
- SCIM delta: we have a CSV export for Nov that records deltas with timestamps, actor, and change type. We will filter to SignalCare-scoped events only.
- Role / owner roster: Laura will pull the latest role-to-permission matrix and the mapped owners. Our RBAC uses a tenant-scoped role model; owners are recorded in the provisioning workspace.
- Attribute mapping description: we'll include the mapping table (SAML attribute -> role rule) and a short paragraph on how the automated assignment is evaluated during provisioning.

We can deliver the artifacts via a shared Drive folder and a signed DocuSign transfer if you prefer an audit trail. Laura, Grace — can you prepare the exports and the attestation language? I'm committing to a draft delivery by Friday EOD but if we run into redaction needs it may slip to Monday.

Amanda — if AuditWise needs the samples in a specific format (e.g., zipped SAML XMLs with sample NameIDs), flag it and we'll conform.

Best,
Sean
Sr. Sales Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

On Wed, Dec 1, 2027 at 09:12 AM Amanda Li <amanda.li@signalcare.com> wrote:
> Sean — thanks for taking this. We're kicking off our SOC 2 Type II evidence collection...

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@signalcare.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Delivery: SAML samples, SCIM delta & role ownership matrix (SignalCare tenant)

Amanda / Sean — attaching the requested artifacts to this thread. For sensitive fields we redacted PII and replaced with consistent pseudonyms so the assertions remain verifiable by pattern but do not expose customer emails. Attachment stubs are below and the full set is in the secure Drive folder (link included).

Attachments (stubs in thread):
- saml-assertion-samples_202711.zip (3 XMLs: user-login.xml, svc-provisioner.xml, service-account-assertion.xml)
- scim-delta-202711.csv (CSV columns: ts, actor, change_type, resource_type, resource_id, attribute_changed)
- role-ownership-matrix_202711.xlsx (tabs: roles, permissions, owner_roster)

Short attestation wording (for your SOC 2 workbook):
“Redwood Inference confirms that role assignments for SignalCare are governed by tenant-scoped RBAC rules. SAML attribute mappings (SAML:groups / SAML:role) are translated into role assignment via the provisioning engine; owners are responsible for monthly review and privileges are revoked on account termination. A sample of SAML assertions and the SCIM delta for Nov 2027 are provided for auditor validation.”

Notes and clarifications:
- The SCIM delta file includes both provisioning events initiated by SCIM and reconciliation events from our periodic import. We kept the two event types in separate columns.
- Role ownership shows manager lineage where available; for contractors without a manager in our directory the owner is listed as the contracting team lead.
- If AuditWise requires raw timestamps mapped to a different timezone, we can re-export in UTC.

Drive link (same as Doc): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBfExampleDriveLink
DocuSign transfer: https://www.docusign.net/sign/EXAMPLE-abc123
HubSpot: HS-8503921

Let us know any follow-ups and happy to hop on a 30-min call if AuditWise wants a quick walkthrough.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Manager, Identity & Access Controls, Redwood Inference

On Wed, Dec 1, 2027 at 11:03 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

From: David Park <david.park@auditwise.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Amanda Li <amanda.li@signalcare.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Dec 2027 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Delivery: SAML samples, SCIM delta & role ownership matrix (SignalCare tenant)

Laura / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attestation language — that's very helpful. A couple of small asks from the audit side before we close the control: 

1) Can you confirm if the SAML assertion samples include the NameID transient vs persistent format clearly labeled in the XML? We need a labeled example for both flows.
2) For the role-ownership matrix, can you add a column called "last_reviewed" with the last owner review timestamp (even if it's an approximate month)? The control tests owners performing periodic review and timestamps make evaluation straightforward.

If you can drop an updated role-ownership tab and a labeled NameID example by EOD Monday 6 Dec, we should be able to complete the evidence bundle for SignalCare. Otherwise we may request the auditor extension.

Thanks — David
Senior Auditor, AuditWise
